title: The General Strike
description: The Workers' Coalition has called a general strike. The railways are stopped. The ports are idle. The steel mills are silent. Soraya Khaled is offering an alliance — with conditions.

title: Budget Allocation — Strike Response
description: The strike has economic consequences that compound daily. The treasury is losing revenue. The IMA is losing patience. Adjust the budget to respond — either fund the strikers' demands or fund the strike-breaking.

title: IMA — Final Confrontation
description: The IMA delegation has issued an ultimatum of its own: accept the full conditionality package or lose access to the standby arrangement. Vostane says they're serious. The question is whether you're more afraid of them or of your own people.

title: Ceasefire — Formal Negotiations
description: The back-channel talks have produced a formal negotiation framework. Gravenmark as neutral territory. International observers. Both sides have agreed to the table — now someone has to actually sit down.

title: Occupation — Life Under the Junta
description: Brenner's junta has consolidated control. The question is whether to resist from within, negotiate a transition, or accept that the country you were elected to lead no longer exists in the form you were elected to govern.
